requirements.text: Customers should be able to book appointments online by selecting a service, choosing a barber, and viewing available time slots, receiving immediate confirmation via text or email.
If an appointment slot is filled, customers should receive a message indicating its unavailability.
Customers should have the ability to log into their accounts to easily change or cancel appointments, with clear options and reminders about the cancellation policy.
Appointment reminders should be sent a day before and an hour before, via both text and email, to help reduce no-shows.
The system should be designed to integrate smoothly with current operations, prioritizing cost-effectiveness and ease of use for both customers and staff.
